column3: Close to the Hebrew; “will escape” is rendered “shall be delivered,” and “the scroll” “the book.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the ground of dust” is rendered “the dust of the earth,” and “reproaches” “shame.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who have insight” is rendered “Those who are wise.”
Close to the Hebrew; “keep secret” is rendered “shut up,” and “they will rove about” “shall run to and fro.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the end of the wonders” is rendered “the fulfillment of these wonders.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will purge themselves” is rendered “shall be purified,” and “they will purify themselves” “made white.”
Close to the Hebrew; “go to the end” is rendered “go your way till the end,” and “your allotted portion” “your inheritance.”
